announcements.headline: Executive Bonus Scheme 2025
announcements.insight: Tertiary Minerals introduces an executive bonus scheme, likely aligning management incentives with the ongoing Mushima North drilling programme updates.

announcements.headline: Mushima North - Phase 4 results and drilling start
announcements.insight: Mushima North Phase 4 results are released following the October update on the planned drill programme. Shareholders should watch for subsequent drilling outcomes.

announcements.headline: Mushima North - Update on planned drill programme
announcements.insight: Tertiary Minerals updates its Mushima North drill programme following the October plan. Shareholders should monitor execution progress.

announcements.headline: Results of General Meeting
announcements.insight: The general meeting results follow the October circular. Shareholders should monitor the planned drill programme for Mushima North.

announcements.headline: Mushima North - planned drill programme
announcements.insight: Mushima North enters a planned drill programme following earlier delineation of higher-grade zones. This operational step follows the September results and October general meeting.

announcements.headline: Circular and Notice of General Meeting
announcements.insight: Tertiary Minerals Plc calls a general meeting to approve the capital raise detailed in September announcements. Shareholders must vote on the funding terms.

announcements.headline: Capital Access Window - Tertiary Minerals Plc
announcements.insight: Capital Access Window follows recent Mushima North delineation. Shareholders should watch for funding terms to support exploration.

announcements.headline: Capital Access Window - Tertiary Minerals Plc
announcements.insight: Tertiary Minerals Plc announces a capital access window following recent high-grade drill results. Shareholders should watch for details on funding the Mushima North project.

announcements.headline: Mushima North - delineation of higher-grade zone
Mushima North - Highest-grade Ag-Cu intersection
announcements.insight: Tertiary Minerals reports high-grade intersections from its Phase 4 drill programme, following initial results in July and pXRF data from Target A1.

announcements.headline: New pXRF Drill Results from Target A1
announcements.insight: New drill results from Target A1 follow the initial Phase 4 results announced in July. This continues the Mushima North exploration programme.

announcements.headline: Non-Executive Director Change
announcements.insight: A non-executive director change follows recent drilling results and auditor updates. Shareholders should monitor governance stability.

announcements.headline: Initial results from Phase 4 drill programme
announcements.insight: Initial Phase 4 drill results follow the June programme announcement. Shareholders should watch for subsequent assay data and next steps.

announcements.headline: Directors' Subscriptions
announcements.insight: Directors are subscribing for shares, indicating personal capital commitment. This follows recent operational updates and administrative changes.

announcements.headline: Change of Auditor
announcements.insight: Tertiary Minerals has changed its auditor. This follows the June drill programme announcement at Mushima North.

announcements.headline: Upcoming Drill Programme at Mushima North, Zambia
announcements.insight: Tertiary Minerals is initiating a drill programme at Mushima North. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent assay results to assess resource potential.
